decisions.reason: Only a brief website mention continues to signal low public commitment, but sunk engineering investments and the need to justify the 2023 product-line launch keep the probability moderate and the decision to keep.
Despite its weaker fit with the announced smart-lighting direction, the dedicated product page and sunk development costs maintain visible commitment, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.

As a core general interior luminaire with its own page and active model launches, it is central to the firm's announced direction and carries high sunk investment, so escalation of commitment keeps the probability low.

As the publicly presented flagship with high centrality to the announced sustainable and intelligent lighting direction, its strong public commitment and sunk resources make withdrawal extremely unlikely.

Low public visibility, weak alignment with the announced direction, and the prior withdrawal of the similar HMI searchlight reduce justification for further escalation despite sunk costs, so the firm decides to drop it now.
